summary: Full QA on the new CircleNav (3 majors + 4 bubbles), Foundation Statements merge into agreements (backend + UI card), and professional Shared-With-Me dashboard section. All target functionality works end-to-end on preview. Backend pytest: 100 passed / 1 failed. The single failure (test_agreements_and_pro_requests.py::TestProfessionalRequestFlow::test_full_flow) is a genuine pre-existing bug in /api/professionals — the endpoint hard-caps at .to_list(100) and MongoDB now has 110 professional users from cumulative test runs, so a newly-registered pro can be truncated out of the response. Not caused by this iteration's changes; must be fixed by main agent.

minor.issue: Hard limit of .to_list(100) in server.py:1282; DB has 110 professional users (test accumulation) so newly-registered pros are sometimes truncated out. Causes intermittent failure of test_full_flow. Recommend paging or increasing/removing the limit.
